description: This file contains utility functions for testing and managing plugin bundles in the openclaw project, including creating temporary directories, writing manifests and files, and setting environment variables.

methods.name: createBundleMcpTempHarness
methods.description: Creates an object with methods to create temporary directories and clean them up.

methods.name: resolveBundlePluginRoot
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem path to a plugin's root directory based on home directory and plugin ID.

methods.name: writeClaudeBundleManifest
methods.description: Writes a plugin manifest JSON file to the plugin's directory.

methods.name: writeBundleTextFiles
methods.description: Writes multiple text files to a specified root directory.

methods.name: createEnabledPluginEntries
methods.description: Creates an object mapping plugin IDs to enabled status.

methods.name: createBundleProbePlugin
methods.description: Creates a probe plugin with associated server and manifest files.

methods.name: withBundleHomeEnv
methods.description: Sets up environment variables and directories for testing within a temporary home environment.
